focus_areas: Anatomical correctness of human subjects (especially lower-left figure)

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the lower-left foreground figure; the legs appear to melt into the clothing. Verify if this is a severe AI artifact or just motion blur/occlusion. image_description: A group of people, including children and adults, are dancing around a tall wooden maypole in an urban park setting. The pole is topped with a decorative crown-like structure from which numerous long, colorful ribbons (streamers) extend downwards. Dancers are holding the ends of these streamers, weaving them around the pole. The background features city buildings and trees.
